subject: Pilot readiness + decision timeline check
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearwell.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 16:08:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot readiness + decision timeline check

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and agreed next steps so we have alignment heading into the quarter close:  

- Scope: 4-week pilot (single model, dev -> prod path, telemetry enabled)
- Success criteria: <10% latency regression vs baseline, embeddings accuracy for search POC, integration with your SSO
- Next steps (you): confirm procurement contact and whether you want Redwood to provide an initial SOW + pricing table for review
- Next steps (us): I’ll send a short SOW + a simple pricing CSV for procurement to run through their template (attached)

One question I wanted to flag up front: with the quarter ending next week, is the approval/budget path still on track to make a decision prior to Nov 15, or should we assume timing will slip into mid-November? If timelines have shifted we can adapt the pilot start window accordingly.

I’ve attached a draft SOW and a pared-down pricing table to make procurement review quick. If it helps, I can join a quick 20-min sync with procurement next week to walk through contract/data/ops items.

Best,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Account Executive
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0192

Attachments: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf (PDF), Pilot_Pricing_Table.csv (CSV)

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearwell.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot readiness + decision timeline check

Thanks Hannah — good demo and appreciated the concise SOW. Short update from our side:  

- We’re aligned on scope and success criteria internally.  
- I’ve looped procurement (procurement@clearwell.com) and the security reviewer; procurement asked for the SOW + pricing table which you already sent — that sped things up.
- One risk: our VP of Product is out through Nov 10 and they lead the final approval meeting. That may push the decision timeline a week.

Can you share a one-pager on data access controls (where logs live, retention options) for the security reviewer? If procurement has what they need, we’ll try to keep decision timing as close to Nov 15 as possible but there’s a chance it slides to the week of Nov 15–22.

Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Data Platform, Clearwell
samir.patel@clearwell.com
408-555-3610

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot readiness + decision timeline check

Hi Samir —

Circling back for a quick timing signal. We’re holding a small pilot capacity slot for the week starting Nov 22 and can preserve that if it’s still your intent to start before month-end. If procurement/security need more time, no problem — just let us know and we’ll propose an alternate start window.

If helpful, Ben (cc’d) can surface a one-time onboarding credit or shortened payment terms to help with procurement paperwork. Would that make the procurement review smoother?

Also attaching a short data controls one-pager as requested.

Thanks —
Hannah

Attachments: DataControls_1pager.pdf (PDF)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot readiness + decision timeline check

Heads-up — if Clearwell signals a likely slip, I’d recommend offering a 10% onboarding credit instead of changing list pricing; procurement prefers a visible credit line. I can approve up to $7k in credits for pilot deals. Let me know if you want me to put that in an email to Samir/procurement.

-Ben
Ben Carter | Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@clearwell.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@clearwell.com
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot readiness + decision timeline check

Appreciate the follow ups, Hannah (and Ben). Quick status:  

- VP of Product returned but the approval matrix has shifted priorities — leadership asked us to defer any new pilots that require procurement negotiation until after our contract renewals in late November. That effectively moves our internal decision window into the week of Nov 29–Dec 3.
- Procurement did review the SOW and pricing; they asked for a short contract exhibit clarifying data retention options (I attached their template to this reply).
- For planning, we’d still like Redwood to prepare the final SOW + an exhibit showing the retention toggles and the one-pager on data controls. We’ll target a procurement review meeting the week of Nov 29.

If you’re open to an onboarding credit as Ben suggested, that will help accelerate procurement’s recommendation. We’ll keep you posted and confirm the meeting date next week.

Samir

Attachment: Clearwell_Procurement_Exhibit_Template.docx (DOCX)
